theorem_title: Divisor reduction: the weighted result descends to every divisor
natural_language_statement:
The weighted local result for a modulus $M$ implies it for every divisor $m$ of $M$.

The proof of Proposition 1.4 opens with this, applied at $\mathrm{lcm}(m, 15)$.
source: Xuancheng Shao, "A density version of the Vinogradov three primes theorem", Duke Math. J. 163 (2014) 489-512, arXiv:1206.6139v2, https://arxiv.org/abs/1206.6139, the reduction opening the proof of Proposition 1.4
